# Scout Brief

## Question

Which papers study systems in which LLM agents autonomously generate hypotheses, run experiments or evaluations, interpret results, and iteratively improve the research process? What capabilities, system designs, evaluation methods, and limitations distinguish them?

## Purpose

Map the strongest work on autonomous scientific research systems built with LLMs and identify designs worth deeper study.
